newsitem.title: USA: Revlon holding co to issue $500 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Revlon holding co to issue $500 mln debt.

text.p: Revlon Worldwide Corp is expected to issue $500 million in 10-year senior discount notes in the private placement market by Friday, market sources said.

Proceeds from the new issue will, in part, be used to finance a defeasement of the $1.15 billion accrued value of the company's 12 percent senior secured discount notes due 1998. The remainder of the old notes will be defeased using a capital infusion by MacAndrews & Forbes Holdings Inc, the company said on Friday.
The new issue will have a four-year zero coupon, one source said. Chase Securities Inc will be lead manager.
Revlon Worldwide is a holding company that owns 83.1 percent of the shares of Revlon Inc stock. The Revlon shares are owned by MacAndrews & Forbes.
